intro: Bloodfury Ripper's Remains are the physical proof recovered from the matriarch of the Bloodfury harpies in the Charred Vale. Sought by Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat, this trophy confirms the death of the brood's ferocious leader, dealing a decisive blow to the harpy presence threatening the local tauren settlement.

p: The Bloodfury harpies nesting within the scorched ruins of the Charred Vale have long posed a savage threat to the travelers and shamans of the Stonetalon Mountains. While culling their numbers thins the immediate danger, Maggran Earthbinder of Sun Rock Retreat recognizes that true reprieve requires eliminating their leadership. Bloodfury Ripper rules her flock almost as a queen, guiding their territorial aggression. Taking her remains is essential proof of her demise, scattering the remaining harpies into disarray and granting peace of mind to the tauren striving to heal and secure their rugged lands.
